set.body: Implement the neurofunctor-inspired ScalaFIM core as typed Scala 3 infrastructure: portable linear operators, spatial domains, morphism routing, sampled operator compilation, QC, provenance, cache contracts, and lazy field views. Acceptance: cross-compiled shared core, immutable algebraic values, opaque ids, smart constructors, explicit Either errors, no JVM-only dependencies in shared code, primitive Array[Double] hot paths, JVM+JS tests, and R parity fixtures where behavior must match neurofunctor.
set.title: Epic: Spatial functor core infrastructure
